text: The Escritoire is a memory game that permanently multiplies a bee mutation's odds by 1.5. It is the least-used block in the pack.
Open the quest book and find the party tab. Party members share progress, so four people in one party fill a bar four times faster.
Waystones: you must physically visit one before you can travel to it. One waystone gives you an empty menu. Two is the minimum.
Trophies drop on Looting, not on patience. Looting III is about 1 in 80. No Looting at all is 1 in 2000.
Wild beehives are two and a half times more common than they used to be. Break one with a Scoop and you have a princess.
The Wyvern Lair is an entire dimension behind a portal staff. Nobody has ever set foot in it.
A princess has an 8% chance to drop twice. Two breeding lines beats one by more than double, because you can cross them.
Put four crops around a cross-crop. AgriCraft will show you a result faster than any other breeding system here.
Thaumic Horizons will clone anything alive that isn't a player. Warded Syringe, Curative Vat, four Victus. Nobody has tried it.
Loot bags contain loot bags. That is deliberate.
Odd Jobs bounties reset every hour. Twenty minutes is a perfectly good reason to log in.
Silver gear comes out of the crafting grid already enchanted, at no extra cost. Smite III and Bane of Arthropods III.
Infernal mobs are the best source of gear on this server. The more words in the name, the better the payout.
There is a quest line in your book that looks empty. It fills in behind you, already completed, after you have done the thing.
Butterflies and bees pollinate leaves. Keep an apiary in a forest and your trees roll mutation dice while you are mining.
Nature's Compass tells you which direction a biome is, and how far. It is sitting in the Discovery quest line.
The Great Work is server-wide. One person finishing a stage completes it for everyone, including whoever is asleep.
Nether fortress chests were rebuilt from scratch. They are worth crossing the lava for now.
Use a Grafter on any leaf block that looks off-colour. That is a new species of tree.
You cannot craft a spawn egg for a creature you have never killed. The recipe asks for what it drops.
A lead helmet is a respirator. Wear one deep underground and foul air stops eating you.
The Twilight Forest is two blocks of water, flowers round the edge, and a diamond thrown in. Not placed. Thrown.
The Uncrafting Table takes crafted things apart into their ingredients, and it works on items from every mod here. Not just Twilight Forest.
Right-click any stairs or slab to sit down. That is the whole mod and it is oddly pleasant.
Every chestplate in the game carries a camel pack now. If your water never seemed to work, that was a bug, and it is fixed.
Hover any piece of armour. It now tells you whether it keeps you warm, cooks you in the sun, or filters foul air.
Chilli warms you. Ice cream cools you. Soup and coffee take the edge off a cold night. Food is a tool now.
Juice and smoothies hydrate as well as cool. Ninety-five of them, and every one restores water.
The Pulverizer turns one ore into two dust. It pays for itself within an hour and it is the first machine anyone should build.
A Tinkers tool gains XP as you use it and levels up. A tool you have carried for a week is genuinely better than a fresh one.
Put a Ball of Moss on your mining tool and you will effectively never repair it again.
Frost scorpion armour is one of the warmest sets in the game here. So is arctic fur from the Twilight Forest glaciers.
The IC2 hazmat suit is now a real respirator, and the best air protection in the pack. It was protecting against nothing at all.
Magical Chalk turns up in ordinary dungeon chests now. That is your way into the Runic Dungeons.
Resource crops exist. There are plants on this server that grow iron, gold and diamond.
Meef Stroganoff is one of the best foods in the pack, and it warms you. The Minoshroom has it.
A bounty's timer starts when you CLAIM the reward, not when you finish it. An unclaimed bounty is not refilling.
Every module on a power suit starts with its sliders at ZERO. Green means enabled, not configured.
A jetpack with Thrust at zero produces no lift at all. Open the Tinker Table and turn the slider up.
Power suits have a weight limit of 25 kilograms. Go over it and you get no warning, no error - you just get slow.
An uncharged power suit is not weak armour. It is no armour, plus weight. Fit a battery before anything else.
Sprint Assist and Jump Assist eat your hunger unless you raise Exhaustion Compensation. The suit will pay in power instead.
Eating the same food over and over restores less each time. Carry four or five different things and it stops.
Twilight Forest bosses are locked in order. The Lich is invulnerable until the Naga is dead. You cannot skip ahead.
An apiary with no flowers nearby does nothing at all. That is the most common reason a new one sits idle.
Unanalysed bees show as Unknown. You cannot breed deliberately until you can read what you are holding.
Analyse a seed before you plant it. Planting an unknown seed into a good line is how you quietly ruin it.
The Tinker Table salvages at ninety percent. Nothing you try on a power suit is permanent, so experiment freely.
Cave scorpion armour filters more air as a full set. The helmet does most of the work but every piece counts.
Metal armour is cold at night and hot in the sun, exactly like vanilla iron always was. Cloth and robes insulate instead.
Enchanted robes are close to nickel for warmth now, and they damp the climate rather than just adding heat.
The Charm of Keeping saves your inventory when you die. It is consumed doing it, which is the point.
Stand still for three minutes and the server stops your thirst and temperature. Stepping away costs you nothing.
Nobody can see your name above your head, and nobody shows up on the minimap. That is deliberate.
A Magic Map shows Twilight Forest structures as icons. Your minimap does not. Make one before you go hunting.
The Smeltery gives two ingots per ore and it is built from grout, which is clay, sand and gravel. It is dirt cheap.
Lapis on a Tinkers weapon is Looting. On this server Looting is the entire trophy mechanism.
Bring a Maze Map to the Labyrinth. Without one you will be down there a very long time.
A dynamo with nowhere to send power simply stops. That is not a bug.
Weeds are off on this server. Nothing you plant will be strangled while you are away.
You cannot lose a bee. A failed mutation hands both parents back, which is why it is safe to grind at.
Extreme Chilli can give you heat stroke, and heat stroke is lethal. That is not a joke.
Nights are genuinely cold now. Dress for the dark or stay near a fire.
Fitting a jetpack and forgetting a parachute is the most common way to die in Modular Powersuits.
The Dark Tower rebuilds its own maze around you while you are inside it. It is the nastiest structure in the Twilight Forest.
The Deep Dark has no sky, endermen everywhere and very good ore. Bring light and bring something that filters air.
Creepers and endermen grief terrain here, on purpose. Put a roof on anything you care about.
Foul air underground does not show in your health bar until it is already hurting you.
Solar generators make heat as well as power. In a desert at noon that is a problem worth a cooling system.
Some mobs out there are not the mob you think they are. Look at the name before you commit.
Ice cream cools you hard. Eating it in a blizzard is a decision, not an accident.
The Outer Lands hit harder than anywhere else here. Bring the best armour you own.
A grave lands where you died. If you died somewhere stupid, that is where it is.
Millenaire villages will occasionally generate on top of something you built. That is an upstream bug and it will happen again.
The world is quiet at this hour. That is usually when something finds you.
Somewhere out there is a hive nobody has broken, in a tree nobody has walked past.
There are bees in this pack that only breed in the End, and bees that only appear if you are doing something slightly stupid.
Twelve dimensions. Most of them have never had a visitor.
The Twilight Forest is permanently dusk. It never gets darker and it never gets lighter.
Something in the cave dimension is said to attack in the dark. One in a million, and never on Halloween.
Every reward on this server was rebuilt around one idea: a reward you can predict is a paycheck, one you cannot is a story.
Nothing here punishes you for being away. Every system only ever pays you for being present.
Bags contain bags. It costs nothing to give you that, and it is the best feeling in the game.
The Last Millenium is the end of time, and there is almost nothing in it. That is deliberate.
Nobody is watching your name float above the trees any more.
Somewhere in your book is a chapter that has never been opened by anyone here.
The Alpha Yeti has better fur than the ordinary ones. It also notices you first.
Every death since the world began is still written down, item by item. Nothing is ever really lost.
There is a sword in this pack that was named by somebody at two in the morning and it is still in the logs.
The Naga circles. It does not corner well. The pillars are there for a reason.
Go to bed. The bees will still be working when you get back - that is rather the point of bees.
It is late. Whatever you are building will look better tomorrow, and it will still be there.
There are {quests} quests across {lines} chapters in your book. Most of them have never been opened.
This world has {dims} dimensions and {mods} mods holding it together.
{deaths} deaths recorded since the world began, and every single inventory is still recoverable.
{armour} pieces of armour on this server now tell you how they feel to wear.
It is day {day} in this world.
{quests} quests, {dims} dimensions, {mods} mods. Nobody has seen all of it.
Day {day}, and the Wyvern Lair still has not had a visitor.
Fit a cooling module to a power suit and it takes over your body temperature entirely. Heat Sink is rough, Liquid Nitrogen makes you immune.
A cooled power suit also keeps its own air. Add a Water Tank and it handles thirst too - that is full life support.
Cooling modules on a power suit do two jobs now: they manage the suit's heat AND your body temperature. The nitrogen one is the best in the game.
Somebody will eventually build a suit that simply does not care what the weather is doing. Nobody has yet.
